// C4.3 S4 / W2-C3 D2-B: standalone 638-cycle replay that writes the 29-column
// fixture format (k,t,q_prev[12],dq[12],e_obj_pos,e_obj_rot,committed).
//
// It reproduces exactly what the S4-T2 acceptance path does:
//   loadTrajectorySpec(config/c43_s4_transport.yaml) -> TransportTask -> DualArmQp
//   q += dq each cycle (ideal velocity servo, as the S3 mock plant)
// and it can use either backend so the cross-algorithm evidence (OSQP vs ADMM)
// is produced by the same driver.
//
// This tool is *evidence tooling*: it does not assert anything and it never
// writes into the repository unless the caller points --out there.
//
// Usage:
//   replay --out /tmp/x.csv [--solver osqp|admm] [--yaml <path>]

#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "dual_arm_object_task/trajectory.hpp"
#include "dual_arm_qp_controller/transport_task.hpp"
#include "dual_arm_qp_core/admm_solver.hpp"
#include "dual_arm_qp_core/dual_arm_qp.hpp"

namespace {

constexpr int kJoints = 12;
using Q12 = Eigen::Matrix<double, kJoints, 1>;

}  // namespace

int main(int argc, char ** argv) {
  std::string out_path;
  std::string solver_name = "osqp";
  std::string yaml = "src/dual_arm_qp_controller/config/c43_s4_transport.yaml";
  for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
    if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "--out") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
      out_path = argv[++i];
    } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "--solver") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
      solver_name = argv[++i];
    } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "--yaml") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
      yaml = argv[++i];
    } else {
      std::fprintf(stderr, "usage: %s --out <csv> [--solver osqp|admm] [--yaml <path>]\n",
                   argv[0]);
      return 1;
    }
  }
  if (out_path.empty()) {
    std::fprintf(stderr, "--out is required\n");
    return 1;
  }

  const auto spec = dual_arm_object_task::loadTrajectorySpec(yaml);
  if (spec.phases.size() == 0) {
    std::fprintf(stderr, "cannot load trajectory spec from %s\n", yaml.c_str());
    return 1;
  }

  const dual_arm_object_task::FrozenObjectTrajectory traj(spec);

  dual_arm::DualArmKinematics kin;
  dual_arm_qp::DualArmQpParams p;
  dual_arm_qp::defaultS622Limits(&p.q_min, &p.q_max, &p.v_max);
  p.dt = 0.008;
  p.kp_rel = 10.0;
  p.w_rel = 1.0;
  p.w_slack = 1000.0;
  p.w_center = 1.0e-4;
  p.w_reg = 1e-6;
  p.kp_obj = 20.0;
  p.w_obj = 1.0;
  p.w_slack_obj = 1000.0;

  dual_arm_qp_controller::TransportTaskConfig cfg;
  dual_arm_qp_controller::TransportTask task(kin, cfg);

  std::shared_ptr<dual_arm_qp::QpSolver> solver;
  if (solver_name == "admm") {
    dual_arm_qp::AdmmOptions opts;
    opts.max_iter = 20000;
    opts.eps_abs = 1e-10;
    opts.eps_rel = 1e-10;
    solver = std::make_shared<dual_arm_qp::AdmmSolver>(opts);
  } else {
    solver = dual_arm_qp::makeDefaultSolver();
  }
  dual_arm_qp::DualArmQp qp(kin, p, solver);

  // The S3 ff_1 run starts from the S2 frozen grasp configuration; the fixture's
  // first row carries it, so take the start pose from the transport task's own
  // default (defaultHomeQ) to stay independent of any fixture file.
  Q12 q = dual_arm_qp_controller::defaultHomeQ();
  std::string err;
  if (!task.start(spec, q, &err)) {
    std::fprintf(stderr, "task.start failed: %s\n", err.c_str());
    return 1;
  }

  std::FILE * f = std::fopen(out_path.c_str(), "w");
  if (f == nullptr) {
    std::fprintf(stderr, "cannot write %s\n", out_path.c_str());
    return 1;
  }
  std::fprintf(f, "k,t");
  for (int i = 0; i < kJoints; ++i) std::fprintf(f, ",q_prev%d", i);
  for (int i = 0; i < kJoints; ++i) std::fprintf(f, ",dq%d", i);
  std::fprintf(f, ",e_obj_pos_m,e_obj_rot_rad,committed,des_px,des_py,des_pz\n");

  int cycles = 0;
  int noncommitted = 0;
  double worst_terminal_pos = 0.0;
  for (int k = 0; k < 638; ++k) {
    const auto smp = task.sample(q);
    const auto out = task.step(q, qp);
    if (!out.converged || out.failure_code == nullptr || out.failure_code[0] != '\0') {
      std::fprintf(stderr, "cycle %d failed: converged=%d code=%s\n", k,
                   static_cast<int>(out.converged),
                   out.failure_code ? out.failure_code : "(null)");
      std::fclose(f);
      return 2;
    }
    if (!out.committed) ++noncommitted;
    std::fprintf(f, "%d,%.17g", k, smp.t_traj);
    for (int j = 0; j < kJoints; ++j) std::fprintf(f, ",%.17g", q[j]);
    for (int j = 0; j < kJoints; ++j) std::fprintf(f, ",%.17g", out.dq[j]);
    const dual_arm::Iso3 Td = traj.at(smp.t_traj, nullptr);
    std::fprintf(f, ",%.17g,%.17g,%d,%.17g,%.17g,%.17g\n", smp.e_obj_pos_m,
                 smp.e_obj_rot_rad, out.committed ? 1 : 0, Td.translation().x(), Td.translation().y(),
                 Td.translation().z());
    q += out.dq;
    worst_terminal_pos = smp.e_obj_pos_m;
    ++cycles;
  }
  std::fclose(f);

  const auto last = task.sample(q);
  std::printf("solver=%s cycles=%d noncommitted=%d terminal_e_obj=%.6e m / %.6e rad\n",
              solver_name.c_str(), cycles, noncommitted, last.e_obj_pos_m,
              last.e_obj_rot_rad);
  std::printf("wrote %s\n", out_path.c_str());
  (void)worst_terminal_pos;
  return 0;
}
